description: Use this when the user asks what is on tonight, today's scores, or a given day's games ('NBA games on 2026-11-05'). Returns that day's games with game_id, times (US Eastern), live or final scores, pre-game win probabilities, last-game starters (NBA) and recent injury status changes. Not for a game weeks away or one team's schedule: use find_game.

date.description: Optional date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit for the current/next slate with injury changes.

name: tonight_slate
title: Tonight Slate & Live Scores
